look: Cathedral Gargoyle Lord, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Ruin Gargoyles family: bell-tower-sized gargoyle lord with cathedral ornament carved into its stone. Family anatomy: stone gargoyles and imps with bat wings, horns and pebbled stone skin. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are slate-grey grit crystal. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, vivid sweeping stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
